newsitem.title: UK: BFI up five as freight market strength continues.
newsitem.headline: BFI up five as freight market strength continues.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose five points on Thursday to 1,445 with the freight market showing continued all round strength.

Brokers said that in the grain trades Hanjin booked Scenery Sea 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for mid-Dec at between $24 and $24.50 no combination, and Cargill fixed Patmos for 60,000 heavy grain USGulf to Hamburg for Dec 10/19 at a lumpsum equivalent of $13.10.
Choyang were reported to have fixed Paiute 70,000 dwt delivery Quebec about Dec 8/10 for a trip to the Far East at close to $15,000 daily.
There has also been a relatively high volume of period fixing of Panamaxes east and west, brokers said.
Caper rates were also strengthening, notably in the Pacific, and handy-size rates from Argentina and Brazil were especially firm and were also improving from the Continent.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was also reflecting the firmer rates and increased optimism in the underlying market and showed gains of between 20 and five points in a turnover of 251 lots.
